ambient_events: Four tunnels meet here and each one breathes a different smell into the dark.
Water drips from a hundred small cracks, keeping a rhythm the room seems to like.
Something small scurries along a ledge just past the edge of your light.
description: A wide trunk junction where several storm lines converge under a low brick vault. Painted numbers on the walls have faded to ghosts — a maintenance map for crews that stopped coming a long time ago. From here the system runs deeper and darker in every direction.
name: Trunk Junction
